description: Hand-derived total power of catalog assets: the nameplate power each element states once (ratedPowerW, with its basis) plus the metabolic heat of every living body at the activity of the default pose, max(basal, met * W per m2 per met * skin area). A heat pump counts the electrical input of compressor and fan, not its heating capacity; heat emitters fed from elsewhere are passive (0 W). The arithmetic is written out so any implementation can check it.

cases.derivation: 2 kW jug kettle: electrical input 2000 W
body 1.8 met * 58.15 W/m2/met * 1.675 m2 = 175.32 W; the hob under the pot draws 1500 W
body 1.2 met * 58.15 W/m2/met * 1.675 m2 = 116.88 W; no device
12 kW heating capacity at about COP 4.4: compressor input 2700 W + fan 150 W; the capacity itself is not counted
20 t articulated loader: rated engine output 150 kW; the heat of its exhaust and tyres is not power
a radiator draws nothing (its 1.2 kW is heat delivered by the circuit): passive, 0 W stated explicitly
no living body and no rated element: 0 W
